## Triage: first grade, `documentation` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:api`, `pm:on-hold` until the console pin carries objectui `29b99490`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T06:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` is `domain:spec`.
- **Why p3:** four shipped sentences overclaim, and only for the promoted route. The authored-def refusal they explain is still right, so no wrong answer is served.
- **Why on hold:** the card's own timing check fails today. objectstack's `.objectui-sha` is `20c6d351ad`, from objectui `main` on 2026-10-09, and objectui `29b99490` is NOT an ancestor of it. So the old sentences are still true of the console objectstack ships.
- **Re-entry condition (one):** `.objectui-sha` carries `29b99490` or later. Triage reads that pin every round and moves this card to `pm:queue` when it does. ⛔ A pin bump is not opened for this card alone.
- **Direction, when it re-enters:**
  - Reword the four sentences (around `:151`, `:196`, `:236` and `:267`) so the promoted route is named. The authored `bulkActionDefs[].params` refusal stays.
  - The remedy names the promoted route: declare the action on the object with a field-backed param, and name it in `bulkActions`.
  - The widget-config prescription states which field settings the promoted route carries. Re-measure against objectui `main` before rewording, since the lookup settings were not forwarded at `29b99490`.
  - Regenerate the references. `Clause-②: no`.

Claim: PM loop round 3 · 2026-10-11T13:11Z

- `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts`: the four sentences triage names (about `:151`, `:196`, `:236` and `:267`), reworded so the PROMOTED route is named.
  - The authored `bulkActionDefs[].params` refusal stays.
  - The remedy names the promoted route: declare the action on the object with a field-backed param, and name it in `bulkActions`.
  - The widget-config prescription states which field settings the promoted route carries, re-measured against objectui `main`.
- The regenerated references, and any pin that reads those sentences.
- One `.changeset/22780-*.md` (`@objectstack/spec` `patch`), or `skip-changeset` if only comments move.
- ⛔ No schema shape change. ⛔ No objectui edit.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (no path-derived mandate). Describe text on a published schema owes the at-tier contract review.
Clause-②: no (describe and guidance text only; the accept set does not move)
Responsibility: four shipped sentences overclaim since objectui#12119 (`29b99490`) | the authored-def refusal stays right | an AI author reading the guidance is told a route the console now serves does not exist
Thread-read: 6109279475
Prior rulings read: triage `6106434300` (direction) and `6109279475` (re-entry); objectui#12105 "Done when"; objectui#12119 and its contract review `6106031964`.
Serial constraints cleared: none of the 8 open PRs touches `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action*`; their file lists were read in this act.

This act moves the card `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigns `marchtian`.
